docs.title: Component Selection for Design
docs.text:
Tempature & Humidity Sensing Transmission

**Component 1: Temperature & Humidity Sensor ** Pros Cons Option 1. 1188-SNS-DHT11-ND$3.95/eachlink to product * high humidity range* Only needs one GPIO pin * Compact for small project deisgn * Lower accuracy* Maximum sampling rate 1HZ * Option 2. * CANADUINO 26085 * $2.39/each * Link to product * Cheaper than other options * Wide voltage range * 16 bit output provides high resolution data * Low relative humidity(RH) limit * lower quality DHT11 * Option 3. * 1188-SNS-DHT22-ND * $7.30/each * Link to product *High precision * Fast response time * Industry Stadard * Expensive * Harder to hand solder * Require external pull-up resistors

Choice: Option 1: 1188-SNS-DHT11-ND Sensor

Rationale: Since our design does not require precise readings and operates natively on a 5V rail, the DHT11 is the best choice. Not only is the component within budget constraints, it also only uses one GPIO pin leaving the remaining pins open for UART communication.

**Component 2: 5v Linear Voltage Regulator ** Pros Cons Option 1. L7805ABV-DG$1.53/eachlink to product * High output accuracy* Wide operating temperature * Stable over a wide input voltage range * Gets hot too quickly * Requires a minimum of 2v dropout voltage * Option 2. * MC7805CTGOS-ND$1.01/each * Link to product * Low dropout voltage * Built in heatsink * High current capability * Poor power efficiency * Maximum output current limited to 250 mA * Consumes a operating current of 5mA to 6.5mA * Option 3. * MCP1700-5002E/TO-ND * $0.50/each * Link to product *Extremely inexpensive * Very low operating current(µA) * Built in circuit protection * Narrow input voltage margin * Requires input/output filter capacitros for sabaility

Choice: Option 1: L7805ABV-DG

Rationale: The L7805ABV-DG was selected due to its capability of sourcing a 1.5A max output current which will provide a safe current for our design and its built in circuit protection incase of a short circuit. It is also a standard stock component, even being used in some of the in class Lab, also providing thermal protection feature such as a heatsink to reduce heat with high voltage.

**Component 3: External Power Supply ** Pros Cons Option 1.993-PSAC05R-050L6-R-ND$5.56/eachlink to product * high efficiency * Reliable output * Interchangeable AC plugs * AC plugs sold separately* Limited to 5 watts * Option 2. * 839-16-00078-ND * $7.51/each * Link to product * Wide input range * Standard output connector * High energy efficiecy * Low power output * Low operating tempature * Option 3. * WSU120-0700 * $7.58/each * Link to product *Clean and regulated output * Long cord length * Affordable * Narrow operating temperature

Choice: Option 3: WSU120-0700 AC/DC WALL MNT ADAPTER 12V 8.4W

Rationale: The WSU120-0700 was chosen since it satisfies the regulator dropout requirements, for example our chosen voltage regulator requires a minimum of 7 volts which our 12V DC output satisfies. The 700 mA at 12v DC provides significant current headroom to pass the 25 percent current safety margin, it also has a integrated barrel plug that is compatible with the barrel jack on our PCB.
